entities.summary: Ksente Bogoev was a prominent economist, professor and Prime Minister of the Socialist Republic of Macedonia within the former Yugoslavia and Head of the National Bank of Yugoslavia in 1977. He was a member and chairman (1992–1997) of the Macedonian Academy of Sciences and Arts.
